note: AI-generated personas. Not real people and not real experts.

personas.name: Requirements Engineering Specialist
personas.criteria: How settled or volatile the requirements are; revisions and conflicts; stakeholder availability to clarify; open clarifications; quality of acceptance criteria.

personas.name: Software Architecture Specialist
personas.criteria: Integration and legacy-system dependence; technical risk and uncertainty; system size and complexity; whether architecture-critical decisions need early risk reduction or can evolve incrementally.

personas.name: Financial-Systems Project Manager
personas.criteria: Budget and schedule constraints; fixed external deadlines; required release cadence; stakeholder access; predictability of scope; control of delivery risk.

personas.name: Security/DevSecOps Specialist
personas.criteria: Threat and security risk; the need to integrate security controls into delivery; continuous deployment needs; consequences of a security failure.

personas.name: Regulated-Systems Engineering Specialist
personas.criteria: Regulatory criticality; need for formal verification and validation; traceability; audit documentation; consequences of system failure.
